destination.description: Inert pass-through. Present so verify-catalog's probe values do not fail strict additionalProperties:false validation; the chart itself does not consume this field.

groupPrefix.description: Prefix the kube-apiserver adds to every OIDC group (claimMappings.groups.prefix).

roles.description: ZITADEL role keys (without prefix) bound to cluster-admin / edit / view. Empty = no binding.

enabled.description: Read-only on cluster-scoped objects (namespaces, nodes, storage, CRDs, classes) for edit and view.
